diagnoses.reported_issue: Cracked front display and device overheating while charging.
diagnoses.technician_findings: Display glass fractured. Thermal test indicates battery health degraded to 76%.
diagnoses.root_cause: Drop damage fractured glass. High cycle count degraded battery capacity.
diagnoses.recommended_solution: Replace OLED Display assembly and high capacity Li-Ion battery.
diagnoses.internal_technician_notes: Tested on DC power supply, board draw is normal.
